content:
Check the dates on the prefs files. If the highest numbered one has a current date, you could

  1. exit thunderbird
  2. copy the existing prefs.js elsewhere (in case things go wrong)
  3. then delete the prefs.js and rename that other one to be prefs.js and restart thunderbird

Be sure to check the dates.

This does not fix the problem, but it may show the account you created. VPNs can be problems. Any software that is security aware is suspect.
